external_requirement_assessments.assessment_basis: NIST AC-3 calls for enforcement of authorised logical access to protected resources. Anthropic reports actual extraction of a student-personal-data store from the compromised education provider and retrieval of citizen records at a government target. These particular unauthorised information operations conflict with access enforcement; the report does not prove that every probed system failed an access boundary.
